title: Pets and light pets (a first batch with Terraria names)
player_outcome: Equipping a pet brings a small companion that follows you. Equipping a light pet (Shadow Orb, Crimson Heart, …) brings a floating glow that lights caves as you explore.
design: ProjectileDef.Pet = PetDef { Flies (bool), Speed (m/s), Follow (m), Hover (m) }. Pets are Friendly = false and Contact = false, and never expire.

New Core ProjectileSystem.Pets.cs, SyncPets(PlayerEntity) each tick: exactly one pet projectile per filled Misc pet/light-pet slot (the item's projectile). Despawn when unequipped or the item changes.
TickPet, fliers: hover behind the shoulder with a gentle bob (the minion idle ring logic).
TickPet, walkers: follow on the ground with gravity via VoxelMotion.Move and hop 1-cell steps. Both kinds teleport when more than 30 m away.

Light pets: the item carries equipEffect emitLight (existing), so PlayerLight shines. Add a PlayerLight anchor func returning ProjectileRenderer.PetNode(owner, light: true) so the light comes from the orb.
ProjectileRenderer: pets use creature visuals (existing path), playing walk/idle/fly by velocity.
Data: a new data/items/pets.json (listed via manifest regeneration) with items, pet projectiles and loot/shop sources.
Assets: assets.json explicit entries for the pet items (orb/heart/bottle generators) and reused creature models (bunny, fish) at small scale.
